entries.build_command: No build required for Python stdlib test.
entries.reachability_signal: Test passes (OK) — the test verifies that Process.wait() returns within timeout after process exits even with grandchild holding pipe open. Covers new lines 245-250 of _process_exited (waiter wakeup) and verifies line 266-271 of _try_finish (removed _pipes_connected guard).
entries.expected_signal: Test result OK. On non-Win32: assertEqual(-signal.SIGKILL, returncode). On Win32: assertIsInstance(returncode, int).
entries.input_strategy: Subprocess spawns a child that spawns a grandchild inheriting stdout pipe. Child is killed while grandchild holds pipe open. wait() called with timeout — must return before timeout. Tests the exact behavior change: wait() returns on process exit, not on pipe EOF.
entries.limitations: Requires Python interpreter with asyncio support on a POSIX system (uses fork, signal.SIGKILL). Test is already in the patched source; before version may hang if the test is run, so contract comparison uses the existing test 'test_empty_input' as a stable behavior anchor instead.
